correctness.rationale: The exact change of variables gives density beta^{-2} sum of three admissible-digit weights. Two open corner regions force beta^2=2,p=1/2 for any putative flat invariant law, while the exclusive-three-preimage region at beta=sqrt(2) forces density 3/2. A complete seven-region table proves balanced p has no other positive density excess and any biased p has an additional one. The exact right-triangle area ratio gives 17-12sqrt(2), and Markov TV contraction yields the stationary lower bound. A freshly executed standalone checker compares 105858 interior branch cases. Finite checks are not used as infinite proof.
